The [[Deldrimor Staff (unique)|Deldrimor Staff]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] traded by the appropriate artisan in [[Droknar's Forge (explorable area)]]. It is available with all caster [[attribute]]s.

== Stats ==
:<[[Damage type|Type]]> damage: 11-22 (Requires 9 <[[attribute]]>)
:[[Energy]] +10
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Energy +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)    
:Health +60

== Skin ==   
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the non-unique [[Deldrimor Staff]].

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Deldrimor Staff]] of the appropriate attribute from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Hale]] [[Staff Head]].
*Perfect [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]]
*Perfect [["Hale and Hearty"]] inscription


Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact replica of this item with:
*One of the following staves with the appropriate attribute:
**[[Destroyer Staff]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Staff]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Staff]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*Perfect [[Hale]] [[Staff Head]].
*Perfect [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]]
OR
*One of the following staves with the appropriate attribute:
**[[Staff]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], or [[Soros]]
**[[Asuran Staff]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Staff]] from collector [[Zaishen Weapon Master]]
**[[Norn Staff]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Staff]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Raven Staff]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]]
**[[Staff of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Charr Staff]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Staff]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Saul's Staff]] from [[Durmand]] (requires the Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Staff]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Staff]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*Perfect Hale Staff Head
*Perfect Staff Wrapping of Fortitude
*Perfect [["Hale and Hearty"]] inscription

==Unique counterparts==
*[[Kerrsh's Staff]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Fire damage]] and requires [[Divine Favor]], [[Soul Reaping]], [[Fast Casting]], [[Energy Storage]], or [[Spawning Power]].
*[[Divine Shadow Staff]] has stats identical to the [[Divine Favor]] version of this item.
*[[Banor's Sacred Branch]] has stats identical to the [[Protection Prayers]] version of this item.
*[[Grim Shadow Staff]], [[The Soul Reaper]], and [[Staff of the Hierophant]] has stats identical to the [[Soul Reaping]] version of this item.
*[[The Mindstealer]] has stats identical to the [[Illusion Magic]] version of this item.
*[[Inspired Shadow Staff]] has stats identical to the [[Inspiration Magic]] version of this item.
*[[Moteh's Lightning Spire]] has stats identical to the [[Air Magic]] version of this item.
*[[Shekoss' Staff]] has stats identical to the [[Earth Magic]] version of this item.
*[[Everlasting Shadow Staff]] and [[Prismatic Staff]] have stats identical to the [[Energy Storage]] version of this item.
*[[Exuro's Will]] has stats identical to the [[Fire Magic]] version of this item.
*[[Staff of Ruin]] has stats identical to the [[Communing]] version of this item.
*[[Alsin's Walking Stick]], [[Ritualistic Shadow Staff]] and [[Fozzy's Staff]] have stats identical to the [[Spawning Power]] version of this item.
